title: Customer says they were debited, and quotes a reference
note: The payment says failed; the customer's bank statement says the money left. That is conflicting evidence about whether money moved, and it bars a recovery link outright - sending one would charge them a second time. Razorpay documents that a bank can auto-refund without changing payment status, so the API alone cannot settle this. The customer's own reference can.
customer_messages:
hi team, i tried paying 2340 on 23/01 for my order but
